The store's data is development data, so for several products nobody but you knows what they
actually are. EDIT the copy below before applying it — a confident description of the wrong
product is the single most damaging thing in an agentic catalog.
Fields: title, descriptionHtml, productType, vendor, category (taxonomy gid), tags, price,
or action:'unpublish' to remove a product from the agentic channel entirely.

products._edit: Currently carries a women's swimsuit description, including another company's support email. Replace with what a Stomper actually is.
products.title: Stomper Momentary Footswitch — 3PDT, Soft-Touch
products.descriptionHtml:
A 3PDT momentary footswitch for true-bypass pedal builds and switching systems. Soft-touch actuation rated for 30,000 cycles, with a 9mm threaded bushing that drops into a standard Hammond 1590B enclosure.

Three independent poles let you switch signal, ground and an indicator LED from one press. Solder lugs are spaced for 22 AWG hookup wire. Nut, washer and dust cap included.

  • Rating: 2A at 250V AC
  • Bushing: 9mm, 0.4mm pitch
  • Travel: 1.2mm, tactile detent
  • Contact material: silver alloy

products._edit: An 18-word description that never mentions the product. '700R4' reads as a GM transmission — correct this to whatever you actually sell.
products.title: 700R4 Transmission Lockup Wiring Harness
products.descriptionHtml:
A plug-in lockup harness for the GM 700R4 four-speed automatic, wiring the torque converter clutch to a brake-released, vacuum-switched circuit so the converter locks only in fourth gear under light throttle.

Pre-terminated to the case connector, with a sealed relay, an inline fuse and 1.5m of 18 AWG lead to the brake switch. No splicing into the factory loom.

  • Fits: GM 700R4 / 4L60, 1982–1992
  • Lead length: 1.5m
  • Fusing: 10A inline, included
  • Connector: sealed four-pin, OEM pattern

products._edit: A warranty/service add-on. Seven words of description and a zero price; agents read zero as unsellable.
products.title: Pedal Insurance — 24-Month Repair Cover
products.descriptionHtml:
Two years of repair cover for any pedal bought here, starting on the delivery date. Covers switch, jack and pot failure, and accidental damage including liquid ingress and a dropped enclosure.

One claim per term. We pay return shipping both ways; if the pedal cannot be repaired we replace it with the same model. Transferable once if you sell the pedal.

  • Term: 24 months from delivery
  • Claims: one per term
  • Excluded: cosmetic wear, modification, third-party repairs

Pigment inks rated for 100 years without noticeable fade under glass. Shipped flat between boards rather than rolled, so it needs no flattening before framing. Unframed.
